post_title: Error Importing Alembic Cache from Maya
post_details: Hello everyone! I am trying out Marvelous Designer for the first time and I'm trying to import an alembic cache file into Marvelous Designer. Everytime I do this I get this same message: "Access denied to the temporary folder path. Please select another folder to save the temporary files. A temporary folder is required for the program to run properly." I've tried to run the program in Administrator Mode, restarting my computer, uninstalling and reinstalling the program and nothing seems to change this message. I also ahve 245 GB free space in the location where the temporary folder is being placed. Any ideas what could be happening?
post_description: This web page aims to provide troubleshooting tips and solutions for users experiencing "Access denied to the temporary folder path" errors when importing Alembic cache files into Marvelous Designer.

comments.comment_body: Hello 901875107546, Thank you for contacting us. First, I wonder in which case you got the message starting the software for the first time, importing an Alembic cache file, or else. Second, please try to check those steps below to solve your problem. When running Marvelous Designer software, allow it to run with Windows Administrator mode. If you're running an anti-virus or IT asset management program, please whitelist the Marvelous Designer software. Please give read &amp write permission of the Temp directory path on your Windows user profile.* *For more detail, Location: C:UsersUser nameAppDataLocalCLO Right-click &gt Properties &gt Security &gt Allow Read &amp Write permission If you are not able to find this folder, it may be hidden. In that case, please follow these steps. 1. View &gt Details &gt Options 2. Click View tab &gt check 'Show hidden files, folders, and drives' Hope this help :) I look forward to your reply. Have a lovely day!

post_title: Qt Support was removed from MD10 ?
post_details: Just after subcribing to MD10 I read that Qt Support was removed from Marvelous Designer 10: https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/company/news/view/61 And that's very disappointing. I have made custom asset management tools using Python Qt that works well in MD8. I really hope there is a way to have this Qt support back, either by external linking or having it added to MD built-in Python.
post_description: This web page aims to address the removal of Qt Support from Marvelous Designer 10 and to advocate for its reinstatement or alternative solutions for users relying on Python Qt for custom asset management tools.

comments.comment_body: Hello 901858383383, Thank you for contacting us. We are sorry that we do not support Qt from the version of Marvelous Designer 10. If we have a plan to support it again, we will notice it in public. Should you have further questions, please let us know :) Have a lovely day!

post_details: When I spend a lot of time arranging patterns for simulation in the 3D viewport, if I click Reset 3D Arrangement the patterns fly off into random locations and orientations. Why does it do this? This causes significant problems and is a huge waste of time to try and get them back into position. Why doesn't it return the patterns to the locations and orientations I set up?
post_description: This webpage aims to explain the unexpected behavior of the Reset 3D Arrangement function in simulation software and provide insights into how to prevent patterns from scattering randomly.

comments.comment_body: Hello Tyler! Thank you for contacting us. As I mentioned in the article you posted on the Feedback section(click the link), we have an issue with Reset 3D Arrangement feature. We will come back to you as soon as we hear back from the team. :)
